SELECT S.MATERIAL_CODE BIG_ROLL_CODE, /*钢带编号*/ T.CX_MACHINE_CODE, /*机台编号，用于计算成型定额*/ T.UNIT_CONSUME, /*压延的单耗，用于计算成型可供时长*/ CASE WHEN (NVL(S.STOCK_NUM, 0) - NVL(S.BAD_NUM, 0) + NVL(S.MODIFY_NUM, 0)) * #{stockLossRate} > 0 THEN (NVL(S.STOCK_NUM, 0) - NVL(S.BAD_NUM, 0) + NVL(S.MODIFY_NUM, 0)) * #{stockLossRate} ELSE 0 END TODAY_STOCK, /*当日库存计算公式：(库存量 - 不良数 + 修正数) ，不能小于0*/ CASE WHEN (NVL(S.STOCK_NUM, 0) - NVL(S.BAD_NUM, 0) + NVL(S.MODIFY_NUM, 0)) * #{stockLossRate} > nvl(T.USE_NUM, 0) THEN (NVL(S.STOCK_NUM, 0) - NVL(S.BAD_NUM, 0) + NVL(S.MODIFY_NUM, 0)) * #{stockLossRate} - nvl(T.USE_NUM, 0) ELSE 0 END STOCK_QTY, /*16点半部件库存量 公式：(库存量 - 不良数 + 修正数) -预计消耗量，不能小于0*/ nvl(T.USE_NUM, 0) CX_USE_QTY FROM T_XWYY_STOCK S LEFT JOIN (
) T ON S.MATERIAL_CODE = T.BIG_ROLL_CODE WHERE S.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND S.STOCK_DATE = #{scheduleDate} - 1 /*库存要取排产日上一天的*/

SELECT MATERIAL_CODE BIG_ROLL_CODE, /*大卷编号*/ CASE WHEN (nvl(STOCK_NUM, 0) + nvl(MODIFY_NUM, 0) - nvl(BAD_NUM, 0)) * #{stockLossRate} > 0 THEN (nvl(STOCK_NUM, 0) + nvl(MODIFY_NUM, 0) - nvl(BAD_NUM, 0)) * #{stockLossRate} ELSE 0 END STOCK_QTY /*库存量，不能小于0*/ FROM T_XWYY_STOCK S WHERE S.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND S.STOCK_DATE = #{scheduleDate} - 1 /*库存要取排产日上一天的*/
mapper.sql: SELECT S.BIG_ROLL_CODE BIG_ROLL_CODE, /*大卷编号*/ nvl(S.TODAY_STOCK, 0) * NVL(B.ACT_CLOTH_LENGTH, NVL(TO_NUMBER(P1.PARAM_VALUE), 400)) STOCK_QTY /*库存量，由大卷换算成米数*/ FROM T_XWYY_ASSIST_REQUIREMENT S LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BIG_ROLL_CODE, MAX(ACT_CLOTH_LENGTH) ACT_CLOTH_LENGTH FROM T_CD90_BIG_ROLL WHERE DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY BIG_ROLL_CODE ) B ON B.BIG_ROLL_CODE = S.BIG_ROLL_CODE LEFT JOIN T_XWYY_PARAMS P1 ON P1.PARAM_CODE = 'STANDARD_SIZE' AND P1.DEL_FLAG = '0' WHERE S.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND S.SCHEDULE_DATE = #{scheduleDate}
mapper.select: SELECT CI.CORD_SPEC BIG_ROLL_CODE, nvl(SUM(S.STOCK_QTY * CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT), 0) STOCK_QTY FROM ( SELECT S.MATERIAL_CODE CLOTH_CODE, /*帘布编号*/ (NVL(S.STOCK_NUM, 0) - NVL(S.BAD_NUM, 0) + NVL(S.MODIFY_NUM, 0)) * #{stockLossRate} STOCK_QTY /*16点半部件库存量 公式：(库存量 - 不良数 + 修正数) - 预计消耗量*/ FROM T_CD90_STOCK S WHERE S.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND S.STOCK_DATE = #{scheduleDate} - 1 /*库存要取排产日上一天的*/ ) S INNER JOIN ( SELECT TIRE_FABRIC_CODE, AVG(TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT) / 1000 / #{breadth} TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT, MAX(CORD_SPEC) CORD_SPEC FROM ( SELECT CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE1 TIRE_FABRIC_CODE, CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT1 TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT, CORD_SPEC CORD_SPEC FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI WHERE CI.DEL_FLAG = '0' UNION SELECT CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE2 TIRE_FABRIC_CODE, CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT2 TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT, CORD_SPEC CORD_SPEC FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI WHERE CI.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE2 IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE3 TIRE_FABRIC_CODE, CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT3 TIRE_FABRIC_CRAFT, CORD_SPEC CORD_SPEC FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO CI WHERE CI.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE3 IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY TIRE_FABRIC_CODE ) CI ON CI.TIRE_FABRIC_CODE = S.CLOTH_CODE GROUP BY CI.CORD_SPEC
select param_code, param_value from T_CD90_PARAMS where DEL_FLAG = '0' and param_code = #{paramCode}
SELECT BIG_ROLL_CODE, REMIND_FLAG FROM T_XWYY_BIG_ROLL_REMIND t WHERE t.DEL_FLAG = '0'
